name: clock_any_negative_only
want: A32 scheduled reset: fixture passes
first_fail: A32 scheduled reset: fixture passes
meaning: the intended step-128 reset would HOLD (attempt-3 checker)

name: clock_regress_allowed
want: A32 same-episode clock regress -> sensor_timestamp
first_fail: A32 same-episode clock regress -> sensor_timestamp
meaning: a clock that runs backwards outside the scheduled reset passes

name: clock_stall_allowed
want: A32 same-episode clock stall (constant time) -> sensor_timestamp
first_fail: A32 same-episode clock stall (constant time) -> sensor_timestamp
meaning: a stalled clock passes

name: clock_after_reset_unchecked
want: A32 clock after the reset not at one control step -> sensor_timestamp
first_fail: A32 clock after the reset not at one control step -> sensor_timestamp
meaning: any restart time after the reset passes

name: episode_plus_one_relaxed
want: A32 episode jumps by 2 at the scheduled reset -> stale_packet
first_fail: A32 episode jumps by 2 at the scheduled reset -> stale_packet
meaning: episode +2 at the scheduled reset passes

name: termination_not_checked
want: A32 an unscheduled termination with a real reset is its own HOLD
first_fail: A32 an unscheduled termination with a real reset is its own HOLD
meaning: automatic resets are not separately flagged

name: timeout_not_checked
want: A32 a timeout flag -> unscheduled_termination
first_fail: A32 a timeout flag -> unscheduled_termination
meaning: timeouts are not flagged

name: reset_marker_not_checked
want: A32 scheduled reset with no reset marker -> reset_marker
first_fail: A32 scheduled reset with no reset marker -> reset_marker
meaning: a reset without a marker passes

name: ray_start_xy_not_checked
want: A32 ray start XY 1 cm off the analysis XY -> ray_start_xy
first_fail: A32 ray start XY 1 cm off the analysis XY -> ray_start_xy
meaning: ray start frame is not compared with the analysis XY

name: ray_direction_not_checked
want: A32 tilted ray direction -> ray_direction
first_fail: A32 tilted ray direction -> ray_direction
meaning: a tilted ray passes

name: ray_start_height_not_checked
want: A32 rays that start below the terrain surface -> ray_start_height
first_fail: A32 rays that start below the terrain surface -> ray_start_height
meaning: rays under the ground pass (the gap_90 fall)

name: boundary_threshold_changed
want: A32 scheduled reset: fixture passes
first_fail: A32 scheduled reset: fixture passes
meaning: the shared boundary formula drifts from the fixture's

name: gravity_left_on
want: A32 eight_case cfg: gravity off for the robot
first_fail: A32 eight_case cfg: gravity off for the robot
meaning: the diagnostic robot falls again

name: illegal_contact_termination_kept
want: A33 eight_case cfg: illegal_contact termination removed, time_out kept
first_fail: A33 eight_case cfg: illegal_contact termination removed, time_out kept
meaning: contact resets come back

name: fixed_pose_flag_always_true
want: A32 fixed_pose_ok false when the pose moves 5 cm in warmup
first_fail: A32 fixed_pose_ok false when the pose moves 5 cm in warmup
meaning: a moving robot is certified fixed

name: mesh_flag_always_true
want: A32 unverified evidence leaves mesh_collision_verified false and the checker HOLDs
first_fail: A32 unverified evidence leaves mesh_collision_verified false and the checker HOLDs
meaning: unverified collision evidence is certified

name: scope_not_required_by_checker
want: A32 evidence without the sampled-scope statement is refused by the checker
first_fail: A32 evidence without the sampled-scope statement is refused by the checker
meaning: the checker accepts evidence without scope and branch result

name: asset_digest_invented
want: A32 asset digest of an unreachable https reference is empty, not invented
first_fail: A32 asset digest of an unreachable https reference is empty, not invented
meaning: a made-up asset digest satisfies the checker

name: mesh_faces_not_compared
want: A32 different face order disagrees
first_fail: A32 different face order disagrees
meaning: different triangle order is accepted

name: evidence_kind_always_observed
want: A32 evidence is unverified when: mesh disagrees
first_fail: A32 evidence is unverified when: mesh disagrees
meaning: any probe result is certified observed

name: occluded_holes_pass
want: A32 branches: every hole ray occluded -> not ok (the occluded-holes counterexample)
first_fail: A32 branches: every hole ray occluded -> not ok (the occluded-holes counterexample)
meaning: a branch with no compared ray counts as satisfied

name: oracle_not_used
want: A32 branches: PhysX finds ground in a hole -> not ok, counted as oracle and hit/miss mismatch
first_fail: A32 branches: PhysX finds ground in a hole -> not ok, counted as oracle and hit/miss mismatch
meaning: the known scene is not an expected answer

name: missing_branch_ignored
want: A32 branches: a scene sample that never looks into a hole -> missing_required, not ok
first_fail: A32 branches: a scene sample that never looks into a hole -> missing_required, not ok
meaning: a branch never exercised passes

name: boundary_rays_compared
want: A32 branches: boundary rays are skipped, and a branch left with too few rays is not satisfied
first_fail: A32 branches: boundary rays are skipped, and a branch left with too few rays is not satisfied
meaning: edge rays are compared

name: robot_hits_treated_as_terrain
want: A32 physx: a ray the robot collider takes is occluded, not a ground sample
first_fail: A32 physx: a ray the robot collider takes is occluded, not a ground sample
meaning: robot collider hits count as terrain

name: physx_errors_not_recorded
want: A32 physx: a failing query is recorded per ray and the loop goes on
first_fail: A32 physx: a failing query is recorded per ray and the loop goes on
meaning: a failed query reads as a miss

name: time_budget_ignored
want: A32 PhysxSampler stops at its time budget and says so
first_fail: A32 PhysxSampler stops at its time budget and says so
meaning: PhysX sampling can run past its time budget

name: sampler_ignores_step_list
want: A32 PhysxSampler records only the pre-registered steps
first_fail: A32 PhysxSampler records only the pre-registered steps
meaning: PhysX is fired at steps that were not pre-registered
